description: Phase11i §4.4 — hand-curated relevance gold-set scoped at the cortex-api IT (rel-001 .. rel-040 from phase11i/k, rel-041 .. rel-050 from phase11j §4.5 — consolidations lane). 10 pre_change_context · 5 decision_lookup · 10 similar_problems · 3 law_check · 2 free_search · 4 phase11k pre_change_context · 3 phase11k decision_lookup · 2 phase11k similar_problems · 1 phase11k free_search · 3 phase11j pre_change_context · 3 phase11j similar_problems · 2 phase11j decision_lookup · 2 phase11j free_search. Each entry pairs a query/intent/scope with 1-3 acceptable hits — recall@10 counts the query as satisfied when ANY entry from `expected_doc_ids` appears in the top-10 fused snippets. The matcher is identical to cortex-cli's harness: composite ids, exact `repo`/`path`/`symbol`/`content_hash`/`collection`, OR substring of `path` / `symbol`. Curators should keep the substring shape (partial paths) so the fixture survives chunk-hash drift.
